content.text: I want to really fully utilize full duplex models in this application for voice. GPT Realtime 2.1 for example is now available, I want you to see what it takes to get something like livekit or some client working that is really similar to GPT Live, I also want to make sure that searching works really well and uses the provider's respective websearch tools if possible. Lastly I want to make sure that the tui properly utilizes all the generative ui tools and fully works with the interface and plugins in pi. Remember that you can test the harness end to end with the api key in the Skate secrets db and the best api key to use for that is minimax-m2.7-highspeed.
I'll start by exploring the codebase to understand the current voice, search, and TUI/pi setup. Launching three Explore agents in parallel.
